scalars.scalar_value: EXPERIENCE: Two years of experience in a public or private health agency, physician's office or volunteer health agency.

items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the qualifications for the Health Services Assistant position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: Experience Requirement: One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester (45 quarter) units. Experience and education used to meet these minimum qualifications must be clearly stated in the application. Missing documentation may result in the experience or education not being counted. Options: I have two (2) or more years of full-time equivalent experience in a public or private health agency, physician's office or volunteer health agency. | I have one (1) year of full-time equivalent experience in a public or private health agency, physician's office or volunteer health agency PLUS one (1) year (30 semester\45 quarter units) of college classes with an emphasis in allied health. (This option requires an uploaded copy of transcripts.) | I have LESS THAN one (1) year of full-time equivalent experience in a public or private health agency, physician's office or volunteer health agency.
EXPERIENCE: Two years of experience in a public or private health agency, physician's office or volunteer health agency.

EDUCATION: One year of college classes with an emphasis in allied health may be substituted for up to one year of the required experience. Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.
